data.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Arabic word 'habaza', which means 'to endure hardship' or 'to suffer'. It is a name of strength and resilience, reminding us of the Prophet Ibrahim (as) who was named 'habib al-lah' or 'beloved of Allah' after having been put through numerous trials and tribulations. The name Habaz carries the meaning “Born from hardship” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Habaz usually hope their child will grow to embody born from hardship and live with faith, good character and purpose.
